title: Mining helper
description: Adds new pickaxes and other things that can help you to mine.
body:
**What this mod adds:**
- New advancements
- New crafting recipes 
- New pickaxes:
1. Tnt pickaxe
2. Metal tnt pickaxe
3. Obsidian tnt pickaxe
4. God pickaxe
- New items that can help you mine:
1. Light stick (summons light when you right click)
2. God upgrade (to update your netherite pickaxe to god pickaxe)
